things.note: Only in the line 'Rebel barons force King John to seal a charter'; no people drawn.
Only named in text, and later 'A king' as text; no figure, crown or portrait.
A generic cream page with grey placeholder lines and a heading bar; reads as 'a document' but not as a medieval charter (no script, no parchment shape).
A cream ring/disc with two short tag strokes at the foot of the page; a plain circle that reads as a seal mostly by convention.
Only a small 'RUNNYMEDE' label under the page; no meadow, river or map.
Only the line 'Most of it: feudal fees and forests'; nothing drawn.
A yellow highlight over a few placeholder lines in the page; the clause's words are then shown as a sentence (see below).

things.thing: clause text 'No free man shall be imprisoned except by the lawful judgment of his peers or the law of the land'
things.note: The sentence is written out in full, building phrase by phrase; it overlaps the shrunken page and seal so 'imprisoned' sits on top of the seal circle.
No person, cell or bars; only the words.
Only within the sentence; 'or the law of the land' is a yellow sticker.
A yellow 'THE LAW' sticker placed above the words 'A king' and the page.

changes.note: No one is drawn and nothing in the picture changes for this; only the written line.
A seal drops onto the foot of the page large and settles smaller at about 3.7 s, like a stamp pressing.

changes.note: A yellow highlight fills in over a few lines of the page (9.9 to 10.2 s); the 'outlive' part is told only by the sticker text.
Camera pushes into the highlighted clause (12.7 to 14 s) before the text appears; not narrated as such.
